questions.q: Minimum center-to-center distance sprinkler heads
questions.n: The code mandates a minimum center-to-center spacing of 1.8 meters to prevent cold soldering and ensure proper spray patterns.

questions.q: Public land and open space which can equally be enjoyed by the members of community and strictly not to be used for erection of any building or structures.
questions.n: Easements are specific areas of public land or open space reserved for community use and utility access where structures are prohibited.

questions.q: How many days prior to excavation should the owner inform in writing the adjacent buildings
questions.n: The NBCP requires a minimum of 10 days written notice to adjacent building owners before excavation begins.

questions.q: What form is the Application of Building Permit.
questions.n: NBC Form B-1 is the primary application form for a Building Permit in the Philippines.

questions.q: What form is the Application of Fencing Permit.
questions.n: NBC Form B-3 is specifically used when applying for a Fencing Permit separate from a building permit.

questions.q: What is NBC Form B-5
questions.n: NBC Form B-5 is used for permits involving temporary sidewalk use and occupancy during construction.

questions.q: If you need a Scaffolding Permit from the Building Official, what Form are to be filled up?
questions.n: NBC Form B-6 is the specific application for a Scaffolding Permit.

questions.q: What is NBC Form B-7
questions.n: NBC Form B-7 is the application for a Sign Permit.

questions.q: What is NBC Form B-8
questions.n: NBC Form B-8 is the required application for a Demolition Permit.

questions.q: What part of RROW found right after the Property Line?
questions.n: The sidewalk is the portion of the Road Right-of-Way (RROW) located immediately adjacent to the property line.

questions.q: Ideal slope of Play Area?
questions.n: A slope of 1-2% is considered ideal for play areas to balance drainage and safety.

questions.q: What slope that doesn't drain well and needs to be paved?
questions.n: A 1% slope is the threshold that requires paving because it does not drain efficiently on natural surfaces.

questions.q: What NBC Form Deals with Notice of Violation
questions.n: NBC Form B-9 is the official form used by the Building Official to issue a Notice of Violation.

questions.q: What form is the Certificate of Completion.
questions.n: NBC Form B-10 is the Certificate of Completion submitted after construction is finished.

questions.q: What form is the Certificate of Occupancy
questions.n: NBC Form B-11 is the final Certificate of Occupancy, allowing the building to be used.

questions.q: Minimum width of a hallway?
questions.n: A minimum width of 1.20 meters is required for standard hallways to ensure safe passage.

questions.q: Minimum distance of the Building Main Entrance to the elevator.
questions.n: The NBCP standard for the maximum allowable distance from the entrance to an elevator is 30 meters.

questions.q: Minimum door width of an elevator? Elevator car minimum dimension?
questions.n: The standard minimums are 800mm for the door width and 1.1m x 1.4m for the car dimensions.

questions.q: Minimum dimension of Rooms for Human habitation (sec 806.1.1)
questions.n: Section 806.1.1 specifies that rooms for human habitation must have a minimum dimension of 2.00 meters.

questions.q: Maximum height of a combustible stand. (sec 1207.14.a)
questions.n: Combustible stands are restricted to a maximum height of 2.70 meters under Section 1207.14.a.

questions.q: Minimum spacing for seats in a chair type measurement from back to back. (sec 1207.14.c.i)
questions.n: For chair-type seating, the minimum back-to-back spacing is 850mm.

questions.q: Maximum line of travel to an exit of an aisle without fire sprinkler system.
questions.n: In unsprinklered buildings, the maximum travel distance to an exit is 45 meters.

questions.q: Maximum slope of an aisle. (sec 1207.12.e)
questions.n: Section 1207.12.e limits the slope of an aisle to a maximum of 1 unit vertical to 8 units horizontal.

questions.q: In standard seating, the minimum spacing of rows measured from back to back. (sec 1207.13.a)
questions.n: Standard row spacing in assembly areas must be at least 840mm from back to back.

questions.q: Minimum width of any seat. (sec 1207.13.b)
questions.n: Section 1207.13.b requires any seat to have a minimum width of 450mm.

questions.q: Minimum area of a double acting door view panel. (sec 1207.3.a)
questions.n: Double acting doors must have a viewing panel of at least 1,300 square centimeters to prevent collisions.

questions.q: Minimum clear width of an exit doorway. (sec 1207.3.c)
questions.n: Exit doors must provide a minimum clear width of 900mm according to Section 1207.3.c.

questions.q: Maximum width of an exit door leaf. (sec 1207.3.c)
questions.n: To ensure doors remain manageable to open during emergencies, no single leaf may exceed 1.20 meters.

questions.q: Minimum width of an exit corridor or exit balcony. (sec 1207.4.a)
questions.n: Exit corridors and balconies are required to have a minimum width of 1.10 meters.

questions.q: Minimum number of exit for floors above the first storey having an occupant load of more than 10. (sec 1207.2.a)
questions.n: At least two exits are required for any floor above the first level with more than 10 occupants.

questions.q: Number of exit for occupant load of 599-999. (sec 1207.2.a)
questions.n: For occupant loads ranging from 599 to 999, the code requires at least three exits.

questions.q: Minimum downward projection of a draft curtain (sec 1204.2)
questions.n: Draft curtains must project downward by at least 0.30 meters to catch smoke.

questions.q: Maximum floor area for an attic made of combustible materials. (sec 1206.3.a)
questions.n: Combustible attic spaces are limited to a maximum area of 250 square meters for fire safety.

questions.q: Maximum center to center spacing of a draft curtain sprinkler. (sec 1204.2)
questions.n: Sprinklers used along draft curtains must have a maximum center-to-center spacing of 1.80 meters.

questions.q: Maximum floor area for an attic made of incombustible materials. (1206.3.b)
questions.n: If made of incombustible materials, the attic floor area can go up to 750 square meters.

questions.q: Standard gauge for metal hoods in barbeques. (sec 1211.2.b)
questions.n: The code specifies Gauge 18 as the standard for metal barbecue hoods.

questions.q: Minimum height of a Siamese connection above grade. (sec 1212.2.e)
questions.n: Siamese fire department connections must be at least 300mm above the ground level.

questions.q: Standard maximum distance of a Standpipe from an opening in a stairway. (sec 1212.2.c)
questions.n: Standpipes must be located within 300mm of a stairway opening for accessibility.

questions.q: Minimum wall thickness of a fireplace. (sec 1211.2.a/e)
questions.n: Fireplace walls must have a minimum thickness of 200mm (8 inches) for safety.

questions.q: Minimum number of exit for a projection room. (sec 1214.3)
questions.n: Section 1214.3 requires two exits from a projection room, sized at 0.75m by 2.0m.

questions.q: Minimum extended portion of a chimney above the roof. (sec 1211.1.e)
questions.n: Chimneys must extend at least 600mm above the highest point of the roof they penetrate.

questions.q: Minimum air space between walls of a masonry chimney above the roof. (sec 1211.1.b.iv)
questions.n: A 50mm (2 inch) air space is required between chimney walls above the roof line.

questions.q: Minimum thickness of glass used for floors.
questions.n: Glass used as a walking surface must be at least 12.5mm thick.

questions.q: Maximum rise of one row of seat to the next for grandstans bleachers (sec 1207.14.c.ii)
questions.n: Section 1207.14.c.ii limits the rise between bleacher rows to 400mm.

questions.q: Minimum number of exit for stands within a building serving an occupant load of 300.
questions.n: A stand within a building serving 300 people must have at least three exits.

questions.q: Minimum height of a guard rail located in front of the grandstand. (sec 1207.14.f.ii)
questions.n: Guard rails in front of grandstands must be at least 900mm high.

questions.q: Minimum width of a run in a grandstand stair. (sec 1207.14.e.i)
questions.n: Stair runs in grandstands must have a minimum width of 280mm.

questions.q: Maximum hieght of a riser in a grandstand stair. (sec 1207.14.e.i)
questions.n: The maximum allowable riser height for grandstand stairs is 200mm.

questions.q: Minimum spacing for seats with backrests measured from back to back (sec 1207.14.c.i)
questions.n: Seats with backrests must have a minimum back-to-back spacing of 750mm.

questions.q: Minimum spacing for seats without backrests measured from back to back.
questions.n: For seats without backrests (like bleachers), the minimum back-to-back spacing is 600mm.
